name: Suzy
source:
A Korean vampire who was turned in the 1880's. Eventually she decided to drift through Europe for about 100 years before arriving in Canada, and came to Langsdon's vampire quarter before it was legally recognized. She decided that it seemed like a cool enough place to settle.

She loves music almost to a fault and will absolutely go on a tangent about obscure artists if provoked.

At heart she's still a bubbly party girl with her finger on the pulse of good music and a decent business sense.

[From [url=https://swb-media.itch.io/creature-consorts]Itch.io[/url]]
